name: swc-plugin-exodra
description: SWC plugin that compiles Exodra JSX (Rust/Wasm port of the Babel transform)
author: Andrei Baikov
_comment_peers: The only specifier this plugin EMITS is `@exodra/core` (src/schema/mod.rs), or whatever `schemaSource` overrides it with. `@exodra/jsx` is here because it owns the JSX types this dialect is written against — the plugin's INPUT, which is the one other package a build cannot compile this dialect without.
